title: Concept: FastAPI traceback returned to a client
description: A Python traceback whose frames run through FastAPI in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The trace names the route module, the service method and often the ORM call, so the next request can be shaped for the exact handler that failed.
applicability: Deployments that render a Python traceback whose frames run through FastAPI into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The trace names the route module, the service method and often the ORM call, so the next request can be shaped for the exact handler that failed.
